notes:
Two things stand out.
First, the record says Marcus has “paid in full every quarter since 2019.” Amanda turns that into:
“consistent on-time payments going back to 2019”

That is not the same thing. Paid in full does not prove paid on time.
Second:
“that decision belongs to the board”

Nothing shown in the case establishes who has authority to waive a late fee. Amanda may be right, but she shouldn’t state the authority structure as fact unless the waiver policy/governing documents support it.
Her tone, though, is very good: empathetic without being excessive, and she doesn’t pretend she can waive the fee herself.
